spawnClearing.source: The widest launch-deck footprint in the game: the largest horizontal distance from a mission spawn to any corner of any `spawn.startGrid` box. Those boxes are Unity built-in cubes inside 2016's own PlayerStart_ElevatorShaft_Photon_02.prefab (see src/render/start-grid.ts), and the six scenes that materialise the deck agree to 13 cm.
spawnClearing.note: DEV-100. A DEVIATION, not a repair: 2016 cleared nothing here — its density maps read 1.0 at six of the thirteen spawns and its own baked draw put a tree 8.86 m from rookie_01_hoverJet's release. Applied in src/sim/props/scatter.ts AFTER the four draws, so every surviving placement is bit-identical and the clearing only subtracts. Cylinders, unbounded in y, because a platform rises straight up and the thing being avoided is occlusion rather than collision.

landmarksConfidence: verified — read directly from the shipped source, no prefab inheritance detected
landmarksNote: Hand-authored placements: everything carrying a mesh that is NOT parented under a generator's `Objects Root`. Transforms are COMPOSED down the parent chain to the environment root (exclusive), Unity space — the frame the terrain transform in the constants sheet is written in (DEV-135; they used to be the mesh node’s LOCAL transform, which for a palm under a `tree_palm_01` node was the origin). `live` is the m_IsActive walk: false means 2016 did not draw it, and Classic does not either. Clouds are excluded — tools/extract/level.mjs already reads them into the level JSON's `clouds` — and so is anything with no MeshFilter (colliders, the terrain root). NOT here: props a MISSION scene places as stripped prefab instances. Those live in the LEVEL JSON now, as `props` in content/levels/*.json, in this same schema and this same frame (DEV-218, DEV-219). Three missions place any: adv_01_jumpSeat 1 live, int_01_jumpSeat 11 live palms, rookie_02_jumpSeat 12 live of 16 authored. This note used to name two of the three and describe rookie_02 as two objects, which is how a 96-reference guid count got read as one prop: count the 1001 blocks, never the references.

_meta.geometry: NONE. This file carries parameters and paths only. Every prop mesh in every shipped environment is bought or a bake of bought geometry — see the per-entry licence field, and docs/private/PROP-AUDIT.md.
_meta.grid: Placement step is TerrainSize / map.width AFTER Unity import rescale. Both shipped maps are 1025x1025 with nPOTScale: 1, so width is 1024 and the step is 4.0 m on a 4096 m terrain. Go through importUnityTexture(), never the raw PNG (DEV-007).
_meta.scatterIsNotReproducible: 2016's scatter used an UNSEEDED UnityEngine.Random inside an editor-only GenerateObjects(), so the shipped layout cannot be regenerated. It was verified to be pure generator output (grid test, docs/private/PROP-AUDIT.md §4): desert is 9,600 on-grid against 53 hand-placed landmarks, and alpine is on-grid once the Tree Pack prefab offsets are accounted for. Nothing was hand-tuned, so re-rolling with a SEEDED prng loses no authored intent.
_meta.shipped2016: A component is not a bake. Only two passes were ever RUN in 2016 — alpine’s Tree_Organic pass and desert’s — and each scatter[] entry’s `shipped2016` says what its source file holds. A pass with bakedObjects 0 is one the 2016 build never drew; this port draws it anyway until DEV-102 is decided.
